description: Chasecall hooks. On session start, quietly show what is overdue. Before any Bash command, stop anything irreversible - sending, paying, deleting, cancelling - unless the user approved it in the last 15 minutes. Reading is never blocked. Every hook goes through hooks/python.sh (step 0 guard): it runs only with a real Python 3 and otherwise does nothing - no Apple install window mid-lesson on a Mac without Command Line Tools, no Microsoft Store stub on Windows; the session start says so in one line.
